Ui.HeaderTagline: DUALSENSE OVER BLUETOOTH: HAPTICS, TRIGGERS & SPEAKER
Ui.HiddenBody: MadSense is in the system tray. To quit: right-click its icon → Exit and release controller.
Ui.ModeSection: MODE  /  CHANGE BEFORE OPENING YOUR GAME
Ui.NativeDescription: Native DualSense. Configure Steam Input for each game to expand compatibility.
Ui.NativeHint:
The game sees a USB DualSense, with haptics, adaptive triggers and speaker where supported.
For native support, disable Steam Input for that game. MadSense does not change Steam settings.
Ui.SpeakerSection: CONTROLLER SPEAKER  /  APPLIES INSTANTLY, ALSO FROM THE TRAY

Ui.WaitingInstructions: Press PS on your controller. Pair it with Windows over Bluetooth first.
Ui.XboxDescription: Xbox controller for XInput games; no DualSense-exclusive features
Ui.XboxHint:
The game sees an Xbox controller: buttons, sticks and standard rumble. No haptics or adaptive triggers.
For games outside Steam that only support Xbox controllers.
